p: ye: This is a consolation for the Church, assuring them that they will never be destitute of prophets by which he exhorts the true ministers of God that then were, and those also that would come after him, to comfort the poor afflicted and to assure them of their deliverance both of body and soul.
warfare is accomplished: The time of her affliction.
double for all her sins: Meaning, sufficient as in Isa 61:7 and full correction, or double grace, while she deserved double punishment.
voice of him that crieth in: That is, of the prophets.
wilderness: That is, in Babylonia and other places, where they were kept in captivity and misery.
Meaning Cyrus and Darius who would deliver God's people out of captivity and make them a ready way to Jerusalem.
mountain and hill shall be made: Whatever may prevent or hinder this deliverance will be removed.
flesh together shall see it: This miracle will be so great, that it will be known through all the world.
voice said: The voice of God which spoke to the prophet Isaiah.
beauty is as the flower of: Meaning, all man's wisdom and natural powers, Jas 1:10, 1Pe 1:24.
breath of the LORD bloweth upon: The spirit of God will discover the vanity in all that seems to have any excellency of themselves.

word of our God shall stand: Though considering the frailty of man's nature many of the Jews would perish, and so not be partakers of this deliverance, yet God's promise would be fulfilled, and they who remained, would feel the fruit of it.
mountain: To publish this benefit through all the world.
your God: He shows in one word the perfection of all man's happiness, which is to have God's presence.
his arm shall rule for him: His power will be sufficient without help of any other, and will have all means in himself to bring his will to pass.
young: He will show his care and favour over them who are weak and tender.
hand: Declaring that as only God has all power, so does he use the same for the defence and maintenance of his Church.
his counsellor hath taught him: He shows God's infinite wisdom for the same.
nothing: He speaks all this to the intent that they would neither fear man nor put their trust in any, save only in God.
will ye liken God: By this he arms them against the idolatry with which they would be tempted in Babylon.
impoverished that he hath no oblation: He shows the rage of the idolaters, seeing that the poor who do not have enough to meet their own needs will defraud themselves to serve their idols.
heard: Do you not have the word of God, which plainly condemns idolatry?
foundations of the earth: Can you not learn by the visible creatures whom God has made for your use, that you should not serve them or worship them?
blow upon them: So that his power appears in every place we turn our eyes.
out their host by number: Who has set in order the infinite number of the stars.
My way is hid from the: He rebukes the Jews because they did not rest on the providence of God, but thought that he had forsaken them in their troubles.
ends of the earth: And therefore all power is in his hand to deliver when his time comes.
understanding: Showing that men must patiently abide, and not curiously seek out the cause of God's delay in our affliction.
Even the youths shall faint and: They who trust in their own virtue, and do not acknowledge that all comes from God.
